q: What do we know about feat-cli-util-v2 in the credit-line-increase project?
a: feat-cli-util-v2 (2025-10-14) replaces the flat 3-month utilisation average with a 6-month OLS slope and a capped over-limit flag, keeping peak utilisation. It supersedes feat-cli-util-v1 and feeds cli-xgb-v2; the slope added +0.012 AUC in exp-103.

q: What came of exp-102, the uplift-versus-propensity test, in the credit-line-increase project?
a: exp-102 showed a T-learner uplift model reached uplift@20% of 1.9 against 1.3 for the propensity score on cli-rct-2025q3 (n=36,000). This became find-cli-uplift-wins (2025-11-25), confirmed in exp-107 on 2026-09-03 and used for the uplift targeting decision.

q: What does cli-xgb-v2 use as inputs in the credit-line-increase project?
a: cli-xgb-v2 uses feat-cli-util-v2 (utilisation slope and over-limit flag), feat-cli-bureau-delta (3-month bureau score change), feat-cli-spend-velocity and feat-cli-pay-behaviour.

q: What is the current CLI targeting model and selection rule for the Q4 2026 batch in the credit-line-increase project?
a: cli-xgb-v3, a T-learner uplift model, selecting the top 20% by uplift score under dec-cli-uplift-targeting (2026-09-22). It replaces the 2025 logistic cutoff of 0.031, and the 1.5% loss cap still applies.

q: What uplift@20% and Qini did cli-xgb-v3 reach on cli-rct-2025q3 in the credit-line-increase project?
a: cli-xgb-v3 reached uplift@20% of 1.9 and Qini 0.081 on cli-rct-2025q3 (n=36,000 randomised exposures, Jul-Sep 2025). The S-learner reached 1.6 and 0.067 on the same set in exp-107 (2026-09-03).

q: Why was the 2025 logistic cutoff of 0.031 replaced in the credit-line-increase project?
a: The out-of-time test of cli-xgb-v2 on cli-oot-2026h1 (exp-106, n=204,060) gave AUC 0.72 with utilisation-slope PSI 0.14, and the randomised uplift results showed propensity scoring under-serves incremental spend. dec-cli-uplift-targeting therefore moved selection to uplift scores.
